title: HOKA Ultra-Trail Australia by UTMB 2027 — Event Schedule
publisher: USM Events Pty Ltd / UTMB World Series
claims: Thursday 13 May 2027 runs the expo and event information from 9:00am to 7:30pm, UTA11 check-in from 9:00am to 12:30pm, UTA22 and UTAMiler check-in from 9:00am to 7:30pm, UTAMiler drop bags from 9:00am to 7:30pm, the UTA11 start at 1:00pm, UTA11 finishes from 1:55pm to 6:00pm and UTA11 presentations at 5:00pm.

Friday 14 May 2027 starts the UTAMiler at 5:00am from Govetts Leap Lookout, starts UTA22 between 6:40am and 9:40am from Queen Victoria Hospital, runs UTA100 and UTA50 check-in from 10:00am to 7:00pm, takes UTA100 drop bags from 10:00am to 7:00pm, announces the UTA100 weather-dependent gear ruling at 10:00am, holds UTA22 presentations at 4:45pm and expects the first UTAMiler finisher at 11:59pm (marked with an asterisk).

Saturday 15 May 2027 starts UTA100 between 5:00am and 8:30am and UTA50 between 5:05am and 8:00am, opens the UTA50 finish from 9:00am, opens the UTA100 finish from 1:30pm and sets the UTA50 finish cut-off at 10:30pm.

Sunday 16 May 2027 sets the UTAMiler finish cut-off at 1:40am, runs 1km-4-Kids check-in from 8:00am to 9:30am with a 9:30am start, holds presentations at 10:30am, lists last UTA100 finishers at 12:30pm and sets the drop bag collection deadline at 3:00pm.
The schedule is labelled a draft and subject to change.
